comparison: All six required fields agree; one independent context one vote.

findings: Two-stage patch chain integrity: core2-report.patch applies cleanly as a pure additive diff to baseline docs/CORE-STAGED-TESTS.md (after line 161) and openspec/changes/consolidated-language-kernel/specs/consolidated-language-kernel/spec.md (under UNI-018, UNI-020, UNI-021), and core2-arena.patch applies cleanly as a pure additive diff against the exact virtual after-state of core2-report.patch (after virtual line 235 of docs/CORE-STAGED-TESTS.md and virtual line 212 of spec.md under UNI-018). Every baseline line is preserved unmodified.

ADOPT M01 (documented-grammar source-to-arena representation in core2-arena.patch): Program retains exact 7 fields (language 'moriarty/2', semantics 'moriarty-core/2', name, states, assets, expressions, actions) with category-filtered lexical declaration arrays and all actions (including unused actions) preserved in declaration order. Action.inputs orders signature inputs followed by leading body input declarations without counting them as statements. State initializers, asset scale/identity, agreement/profile/action identifiers, inputs, await binders, and statement metadata allocate no expression nodes. Program.expressions is one global fresh-occurrence arena across all actions and statements in lexical order without resetting or rebasing at action/statement/await/segment boundaries, allocated in left-to-right postorder without interning, common-subexpression sharing, or constant folding. All 10 Statement variants and their numeric root ExprId fields (including Await.guard allocated at parse time at the await's lexical statement position) match crates/mori-core/src/ir.rs and crates/mori-core/src/parser.rs. The two PR203 Core/1 fixtures are properly bounded as finite precedent without generalizing Core/1 grammar or claiming Core/1-to-Core/2 equivalence, and the undocumented parser token pair 'not =' for BinaryOp::Ne is explicitly excluded from canonization while leaving broader inequality syntax open.

ADOPT M02 (StagePlan layout and PendingFrame ordinals in core2-report.patch): AwaitSite.site is the 1-based per-action await occurrence in source order (with site 0 reserved for idle entry/completion with captures:[]), and AwaitSite.ordinal is the 0-based statement index in Action.statements. CaptureSlot layout orders all action inputs in declaration order (Origin::Input with 0-based input declaration ordinal), followed by all preceding Let bindings (Origin::Let with 0-based statement ordinal) and earlier accepted Await event binders (Origin::Event with 0-based originating Await statement ordinal, preserving binder declaration order) in source statement order, with no liveness pruning and excluding state fields and the pending await's own binders. Actual captures in PendingFrame and Continuation carry ordered NamedValue {name, value} entries matching layout order without repeating origin/ordinal. This matches crates/mori-core/src/stage/plan.rs, stage/mod.rs, stage/admit.rs, and runtime.rs.

ADOPT M04 (trace Step presence, typed outer Step.value, snapshots, and effect deltas in core2-report.patch): Emitted Steps retain 0-based original action statement index (never renumbered per segment), exact admitted IR statement with numeric ExprIds, present typed outer Step.value, complete post-statement Snapshot (state map, (asset,account)-sorted balances, name-sorted liabilities including preserved and present-zero rows), and per-statement new Effect deltas (with Execution.effects as the ordered per-segment concatenation). Reaching an Await ends the segment before guard evaluation and emits no entry Step; an admitted true resume begins its segment with one Await Step at the original statement index carrying outer value Bool(true), snapshot equal to execution.pre, and effects:[]; an admitted false resume emits segment:null and no public Step. Outer Step.value for Let (captured RHS), Requires/Ensures (Bool true), Next (RHS before assignment), Emit (emitted value), Transfer/Fee (evaluated UInt amount), Liability (added UInt amount), and Discharge (discharged UInt amount) matches crates/mori-core/src/runtime.rs.

ADOPT M05 (complete status envelopes and DTO projections in core2-report.patch): Public outcome_report envelopes remain distinct from derived StageOutcome enum serialization, carrying qualification:'local-reference-stage', authentication:'none', consumption:'untracked', plus exact per-status keys for advancing waiting (status:'waiting', advanced:true, non-null segment, continuation, attempted, committed from continuation.logical.committed, residual), false-guard waiting (status:'waiting', advanced:false, segment:null, unchanged continuation, attempted, committed, residual), complete (status:'complete', segment, attempted, committed, residual, with advanced and continuation absent), and rejected (status:'rejected', error, attempted, committed, with advanced, segment, continuation, and residual absent). Advancing waiting resume preserves stored continuation.logical.cap in output continuation without replacing it with a per-call CLI override, and residual filters boundary liabilities to positive amounts (> 0) in name order while present-zero rows remain in the boundary. Matches crates/mori-core/src/stage/report.rs, stage/mod.rs, and stage/admit.rs.

ADOPT M06 (public ASCII export formatting vs separate library serializer and test aggregate in core2-report.patch): Ordinary public 'mori simulate' waiting/complete printing writes one complete ASCII JSON report via outcome_report -> core_io::print -> json::export followed by one trailing LF, empty stderr, and exit 0. Object keys are ordered lexicographically, arrays preserve prescribed order, nonempty containers use 2-space pretty indentation, u16 and u8 (scale) serialize as bare unsigned decimal integers, UInt as canonical decimal strings, control characters use short JSON escapes or lowercase \u00xx (including \u007f), and all non-ASCII scalars use lowercase UTF-16 \uxxxx escapes (including surrogate pairs) within the 1 MiB export ceiling. This public CLI stdout contract is properly kept separate from the library serde_json::to_string_pretty byte check in CORE-STAGED-TESTS.md and from the 'mori test' aggregate output.

ADOPT M07 (local logical schedule and committed-prefix reporting convention in core2-report.patch): moriarty-reference-logical-cost/2 charges 1 per statement dispatch plus 1 per distinct visited Expr node per statement (fresh per-statement cache, eager And/Or), 1 for reaching an Await entry without guard evaluation, and 1 dispatch plus distinct guard nodes on resume. ActionPlan.segment_cost (n+1 entries), committed_before (prefix sums starting at 0), and plan_total (full sum) match crates/mori-core/src/stage/cost.rs. False guard observations report attempted guard work without incrementing committed work. The partial escrow freeze's 5/2/6 attempted and 5/5/11 committed figures remain explicitly conditional until recorded adoption and a distinct independent freeze.

Boundary and M03 alignment: All 14 staged draft gaps (GAP-01 through GAP-14) remain individually OPEN, Core/1 NR-01..06 and financial observation clauses remain separate and intact, and U0..U7, M1..M17, MC/SP/G, mint/burn/accrual, and composition obligations are preserved. Note that the proposals' 'designated-owner UNASSESSED' label for M03 local diagnostic identity encoding is historical relative to the subsequent separate owner adoption in identity-adoption/DESIGN-ADOPTION.json; this ordinary review votes solely on M01/M02/M04-M07 and does not modify the owner-adopted M03 encoding or any authentication, commitment, soundness, conservation, authorization, security, or ledger boundary. No concrete text revisions to the two frozen candidate patches are required prior to recorded adoption and later status promotion.
limitations: Read-only static design review of the supplied public packet only; no commands, Cargo, parser, evaluator, SDK, toolchain, network, or tests were executed, and actual Program, StagePlan, library, and CLI checks remain UNRUN.

Source correspondence verified in this review does not constitute independent behavioral proof or supply complete Program, StagePlan, report, or stdout byte goldens; a separate independent custodian must derive and freeze complete expectations after recorded design adoption.

This review covers only the ordinary representation, layout, trace attachment, status envelope, public ASCII rendering, and local logical-work schedule contracts (M01, M02, M04, M05, M06, M07); it makes no decision on M03 hash/identity boundaries (separately adopted by designated owners in identity-adoption/DESIGN-ADOPTION.json) or on authentication, conservation, soundness, commitment, authorization, cap/refusal precedence, security, or ledger acceptance.

All 14 staged draft gaps (GAP-01 through GAP-14) and all parent roadmap exits (U0-U7, M1-M17, MC/SP/G, mint/burn/accrual, ACTUS/DeFi, composition) remain open until actual conformance and target evidence is recorded.
agreedRequiredFields.summary: Substantive independent non-author ordinary design review of frozen core2-report-contract-proposal/core2-report.patch followed by core2-arena-contract-proposal/core2-arena.patch against the first proposal's virtual after-state. Verdict: adopt-design for all scoped ordinary premises (M01, M02, M04, M05, M06, M07), with zero concrete patch revisions required, preserving the owner-adopted M03 boundary, all 14 individual OPEN draft gaps, conditional partial escrow work status, and all Core/1 and parent U/M/MC/SP/G obligations.
